relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA reversed the complete Freund's adjuvant (CFA)-induced hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA reduced the expression of IL-6, iNOS, and NF-κB pathway in dorsal root ganglia (DRG) on day 7 after CFA injection

relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA upregulated the protein levels of the PD-L1/PD-1-SHP-1 pathway on day 7 and day 21 after CFA injection

relationships.subject: BMS-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal injection of the PD-L1/PD-1 inhibitor BMS-1 (50 or 100 µg) blocked the EA-induced analgesic effect, significantly increased IL-6 and iNOS levels, and reduced the levels of PD-L1/PD-1-SHP-1.

key_findings: Electroacupuncture relieves CFA-induced inflammatory pain and DRG neuroinflammation via the PD-L1/PD-1-SHP-1 pathway; PD-L1/PD-1 inhibitor BMS-1 blocks the effect.
